description: Unit tests for mx_matches_pattern and check_mx_against_policy using RFC 8461/6125 test vectors. Required cases: exact match (case-insensitive), wildcard '*.example.com' matches 'mx1.example.com', wildcard does NOT match 'foo.bar.example.com' (two labels), wildcard does NOT match 'example.com' (base domain), multiple patterns — match first, multiple patterns — no match. Test vectors must be hand-written literals, not generated from the matcher under test.
title: Tests: MTA-STS MX pattern matcher
